name: burninguard-ai
description: BurnInGuard AI 2.0 - Physics-informed, explainable PASS/FAIL prediction for component burn-in screening

scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt && uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload
scripts.dev:frontend: cd frontend && npm install && npm run dev
scripts.train: cd model-training && pip install -r requirements.txt && python anomaly_ensemble/train.py && python drift_model/train.py
scripts.prediction:csv: cd backend && python predict.py --input prediction_input.csv --output outputs/prediction_output.csv
